legal.privacyPolicy:
Data Controller: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: management of wedding invitations, confirmation of attendance, and communication of events.

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (Art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the celebration menu.

Data collected: Expected guest list: the organizer may add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance control; this data is visible only to the organizer and follows the same retention policy. Demonstrable consent: RSVP and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer panel and configuration changes (date, type of action, and technical device data) are recorded. name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age in RSVP for minors), technical browser data (user-agent) upon confirming attendance, and, if you participate in the social functions of the invitation (dedications, songs, itineraries, gift reservations), your name and the message you provide, which are VISIBLE to the rest of the guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the US. Google has subscribed to the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Decision 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with Art. 28 GDPR. Furthermore, Google complies with the EU-US, UK-US, and Switzerland-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF), a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When data needs to be transferred to the US, the transfer is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, the guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup function in their panel) and, in any case, is not kept for more than 12 months. You can also request its early deletion. You can request early deletion at any time by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Creator configuration data is retained for up to 12 months after the event date or as long as the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is executed by the service administrator.

Rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, limitation, portability, and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests can request the deletion of their data by indicating their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent.

Minors: we do not consciously collect data from minors under 14 years of age. If the data subject is under 14 years of age (or the equivalent age according to the country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), the consent of their parents or legal guardians is required.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your confirmation of attendance.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer according to Art. 37 GDPR as the conditions of Art. 37.1 are not met. However, you can contact the controller at any time.

GDPR Complaints (EU/EEA): you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member country.

UK GDPR: for residents in the United Kingdom, the data controller undertakes to comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the EU-US DPF UK Extension, and the SCC have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You can file a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

LGPD (Brazil): for residents in Brazil, the data controller undertakes to comply with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Law No. 13.709/2018). Google complies with the requirements for international transfer of the LGPD. DPO: same controller. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights according to Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/erasure, portability, information on sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, objection.

CCPA/CPRA (California): for residents in California (US), you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal data we collect and for what purpose.
- Request the deletion of your personal data.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

PIPEDA (Canada): for residents in Canada, we comply with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. PIPEDA Principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identification of purposes, consent, limitation of collection, limitation of use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, transparency, individual access, possibility of complaint. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): for residents in South Africa, we comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). We collect your data with your consent for specific purposes. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (US) which offers an adequate level of protection through SCC and DPF. The controller guarantees that the recipient applies processing principles similar to POPIA. You can file a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in the event of a personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be made by email to the provided contact address.

Local storage: this site uses local storage. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or action: the map and translation only activate when clicked. Local storage: this site uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session logged in and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers. By continuing to browse, you consent to the use of this necessary technical storage.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that pre-caches application resources (JavaScript, CSS, and fonts) to speed up loading and allow basic offline use. These resources are stored in the device's browser cache and do not contain your personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

Analytics and error monitoring: with your consent (Statistics option), Wedingo uses Google Analytics (Google LLC) to measure the anonymous use of the invitation and Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., with DPA and Standard Contractual Clauses) to detect and correct errors. These services only receive data if you accept this option in the cookie banner; they are not activated without consent. Furthermore, if the invitation includes a map, the Google Maps view only loads when clicked (load on click): the map may issue Google cookies only at that moment and by your action.

Translation: the 'Translate' function uses the free Google widget (Google LLC) and only activates if the user requests it; the invitation text is sent to Google only at that moment (processor covered by SCC and DPF). Optional contact: if the guest authorizes it (specific checkbox), their phone or email is saved only for event logistics and is only visible to the organizer; it can be requested for deletion at any time.

legal.cookiesPolicy:
This platform uses the following cookies and storage technologies:

• Strictly necessary storage: your language and accessibility preference, and the configuration/admin session (sessionStorage). No personal data is saved in the browser without your consent.

• Local storage (localStorage) and IndexedDB: temporarily store the invitation content (texts, images, and AES-GCM encrypted audio) so that it loads faster and can be viewed offline. They are only used if you accept storage; if you reject it, the invitation is displayed in session mode (without persistence) and saved data is deleted.

• Third-party services (only after your consent): Google Analytics and Sentry (statistics and error diagnosis). Sentry session replay records the session only if you accept analytics and does not record your credentials.

• On-demand actions (without prior consent, by your click): Google Maps to display the invitation map and the Google translation widget. Using them sends your data to those services according to their own policies.

• Service worker: caches the static resources necessary for the app to work offline, without personal data.

You can configure or withdraw your consent at any time from the cookie notice. Duration: necessary for the stated purposes (invitation data is deleted 12 months after the wedding or sooner if requested).

animations.lockedByAdmin: A ti ṣẹ ìkàn rẹ̀ nípa àwọn ogún: o kò lè mú un wá pẹ̀.

envelope-flap.name: Ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àkọlé àkọsílẹ̀
envelope-flap.hint: Ní ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé àkọsílẹ̀, àkọlé náà yóò ṣí dé pẹ̀lú ìgbésẹ̀ 3D. Bí o bá fi ìkó àkọlé náà sílẹ̀, ó yóò ṣí dé ìkíní pẹ̀lú ìkó kan.

envelope-lights.name: Àwọn ìkíní ìrònú níwájú àkọlé
envelope-lights.hint: Àwọn ìkíní orí òṣù mẹ́ta yóò wọ̀n níwájú àkọlé nígbà tí ó ṣìdé, ó mú ìrònú tí ó mú ìrònú.

envelope-flash.name: Ìrònú ohunfun nígbà tí ó ṣí
envelope-flash.hint: Ìrònú ohunfun tí ó kún gbogbo mànà yóò mú ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní ní ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé náà.

envelope-golden-text.name: Àkọlé ìkíní ohunfun
envelope-golden-text.hint: Àkọlé ohunfun náà yóò lọ sílẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìrònú tí ó mú ìrònú nígbà tí ó ṣí àkọlé, ó sì máa lọ sílẹ̀ nígbà tí ó wọ inú. Láìsí rẹ̀, ìkọ̀wé náà kìí ṣe é.

envelope-hint-pulse.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé «Kọ́ láti ṣí»
envelope-hint-pulse.hint: Ìkọ̀wé ìrànlọ́wọ́ tí ó sọ nípa bí a ṣe máa ṣí àkọlé náà yóò máa nífẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ láti kí àwọn ènìyàn máa rí.

envelope-letter-fade.name: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkọ̀wé ìkíní
envelope-letter-fade.hint: Àkọlé ìkíní inú àkọlé yóò lọ sílẹ̀ nígbà tí a bá ṣí àkọlé náà láti fi hàn àkọlé náà.

envelope-overlay-fade.name: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkó àkọlé
envelope-overlay-fade.hint: Ní ìparí, àkọlé gbogbo yóò lọ sílẹ̀ (opasiti àti ìkó) láti mú ìkíní náà wọ inú.

confetti-fall.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ confeti nígbà tí ó ṣí
confetti-fall.hint: Àwọn àkọlé ohunfun mẹ́rin sí èyí yóò lọ sílẹ̀ nígbà kan lẹ́yìn ìkíní nígbà tí ó wọ inú, bí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìṣe.

welcome-video-modal.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní àkọlé ìkíní
welcome-video-modal.hint: Àkọlé tí ó mú ìkíní àkọlé ìkíní yóò tún ara rẹ̀ àti pé ó máa ṣí dé pẹ̀lú ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó nẹ̀nẹ̀ẹ́ àti ìkó.

decoration-sway.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní àkọlé ìkíní
decoration-sway.hint: Àwọn àkọlé ìkíní ìkíní yóò nẹ̀wọ̀n pẹ̀lú ìkíní, bí ó ti mú nígbà gbogbo ìkíní.

decoration-float.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé
decoration-float.hint: Ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní ìkíní tí ó nínú ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní ìkíní nígbà tí o bá wà ní àkọlé náà.

story-transitions.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ láàrin àkọlé
story-transitions.hint: Nígbà tí o bá ṣe scroll, àkọlé kọ̀ọ̀kan yóò lọ sílẹ̀, yóò yí padà, àti pé ó yóò yí opasiti rẹ̀ yá bí ó ti kún apá mànà tàbí ó ti kúrò láti apá mànà.

story-reveal.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ 3D ìkíní nígbà tí ó wọ inú
story-reveal.hint: Nígbà tí a bá ṣí àkọlé, àkọlé àkọlé àkọlé náà yóò wọ inú pẹ̀lú ìgbésẹ̀ 3D díẹ̀ àti ìkó tí ó máa lọ sílẹ̀.

story-smooth-scroll.name: Scroll tí ó nẹ̀nẹ̀ẹ́
story-smooth-scroll.hint: Ìgbésẹ̀ láàrin àkọlé yóò ṣí dé pẹ̀lú ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó nẹ̀nẹ̀ẹ́ ní àkíyèsí nínú bá kò ṣí dé pẹ̀lú ìkó.

story-snap.name: Àkọlé tí ó mú ara rẹ̀ ní ìkó
story-snap.hint: Nígbà tí o bá dá scroll ní ìgbésẹ̀ kíkúrò láti àkọlé, ìkíní yóò lọ sílẹ̀ láti mú ìkíní náà wọ inú mànà.

story-hover.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé nígbà tí o bá wọ ìwé àkọlé
story-hover.hint: Àkọlé tí ó ṣiṣẹ yóò mú ìkíní díẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ìkó nígbà tí o bá wọ ìwé àkọlé.

fireflies.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ ìkíní
fireflies.hint: Àwọn ìkíní mẹ́wàá pẹ̀lú ìrònú ìkíní yóò kọjá ní ìgbésẹ̀ tí ó nẹ̀nẹ̀ẹ́ ní ìgbésẹ̀ mànà.

music-equalizer.name: Àkọlé ìkọ̀wé
music-equalizer.hint: Àwọn àkọlé mẹ́ta yóò kọjá bí àkọlé ìkọ̀wé ní nǹkan ìkọ̀wé nígbà tí orin náà bá ń kọjá.

music-fab-pulse.name: Ìgbésẹ̀ àkọlé ìkọ̀wé
music-fab-pulse.hint: Ìrònú ìkíní yóò wọ̀n àkọlé ìkọ̀wé tí ó ṣìdé nígbà tí ó ń kọjá.

music-card-open.name: Apertura del reproductor
music-card-open.hint: The music player panel unfolds with a soft scale when the button is pressed.

music-icon-bounce.name: Music icon bounce
music-icon-bounce.hint: El icono de la nota musical rebota al abrir o cerrar el reproductor.

music-fab-shift.name: Music button displacement
music-fab-shift.hint: The floating button moves to the side when opening the player so as not to cover it.

music-dot-blink.name: Music notification point
music-dot-blink.hint: El punto que avisa de un error o del estado del audio parpadea suavemente.

music-play-glow.name: Play button halo
music-play-glow.hint: The player's play or pause button emits a halo that pulses softly.

music-spinner.name: Music loading wheel
music-spinner.hint: A wheel spins on the button while the song is loading.

music-fab-hover.name: Music button scale
music-fab-hover.hint: The floating button slightly enlarges when the mouse hovers over it.

music-status-shake.name: Music error shake
music-status-shake.hint: The loading error message shakes to draw attention.

hero-photo-ring.name: Anillo dorado de la foto
hero-photo-ring.hint: Un anillo dorado pulsa alrededor de la foto de la pareja en la portada.

hero-godparent-glow.name: Resplandor de los padrinos
hero-godparent-glow.hint: The text with the godparents' names emits a warm, pulsing glow.

hero-photo-fade.name: Fundido de la foto al cargar
hero-photo-fade.hint: La foto de la portada aparece con un fundido suave cuando termina de cargar.

countdown-tick.name: Cuenta regresiva en directo
countdown-tick.hint: The remaining time counter updates every second. When deactivated, the initial static value is shown.

loading-spinner.name: Ruedas de carga
loading-spinner.hint: Las ruedas giratorias que aparecen mientras cargan la foto de la portada y otros contenidos.

gallery-blur.name: Cambio de foto con desenfoque
gallery-blur.hint: When browsing the gallery, the previous photo blurs while the new one enters sharply.

gallery-caption.name: Entry of each photo description
gallery-caption.hint: The description of each photo appears with a small upward slide.

gallery-lightbox.name: Apertura del visor de fotos
gallery-lightbox.hint: The full-screen gallery viewer appears with an entrance fade.

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Escala de las miniaturas
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: The gallery thumbnails slightly enlarge when the mouse hovers over them.

gallery-nav-hover.name: Gallery arrow scale
gallery-nav-hover.hint: The gallery navigation arrows enlarge when the mouse hovers over them.

gallery-auto-advance.name: Automatic carousel advance
gallery-auto-advance.hint: The gallery moves from photo to photo every 5 seconds. When deactivated, it only changes when the arrows are pressed.

button-hover.name: Elevación of the buttons
button-hover.hint: The buttons on the invitation (RSVP, share, send...) are slightly elevated with a shadow when the mouse hovers over them.

reaction-hover.name: Escala de las reacciones
reaction-hover.hint: The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) slightly enlarge when the mouse hovers over them.

theme-glow-depth.name: Resplandor del fondo
theme-glow-depth.hint: A glow of light slowly crosses the background of the invitation, giving a sense of depth.

landing-pulse.name: Pulso de las pantallas de carga
landing-pulse.hint: El fondo de las pantallas de carga, error y mantenimiento pulsa suavemente.

toast-animations.name: Avisos flotantes
toast-animations.hint: Los avisos breves (confirmaciones, errores...) aparecen y desaparecen con un deslizamiento.

animations.allOffHint: When activated, the invitation is shown without any animation: the envelope does not appear, there is no confetti or transitions. When deactivated, your individual preferences return.
animations.allOffActive: Bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ìdánilá ní àtúnṣe gbogbo.
animations.groupOffActive: Bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ìdánilá ní àtúnṣe ìkànlẹ̀.
